title: Combine User Permissions
real_world_story: An application represents user permissions using bits. Different roles provide different permissions, and the system needs to combine the permissions granted by two roles.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Permission masks assigned to two user roles
real_world_connection.target_represents: Combined permissions available to the user
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Bitwise OR to combine enabled permission bits

problem_statement: Given two non-negative integers representing permission masks for two user roles, combine their permissions using bitwise OR and print the resulting permission mask.
task: Combine the enabled permissions from two permission masks using bit manipulation.
input_format: The input contains two space-separated non-negative integers A and B representing permission masks.
output_format: Print the permission mask obtained by applying bitwise OR to A and B.

examples.explanation: 10 is 1010 and 12 is 1100 in binary. Their bitwise OR is 1110, which is 14.
5 is 0101 and 2 is 0010. Their bitwise OR is 0111, which is 7.

expected_algorithm.name: Bit Manipulation
expected_algorithm.reason: Bitwise OR combines the permission bits that are enabled in either of the two permission masks.

hint: Represent the permission masks as integers.
A permission remains enabled if it is enabled in either mask.
real_world_takeaway: Bit masks allow applications to store and combine many permission settings efficiently inside a single integer.
